news.title: Tyson Foods cuts fiscal 2026 profit forecast again on beef losses
news.summary: The meatpacker now expects fiscal 2026 adjusted operating income of $1.85 billion to $2.05 billion, down from a forecast issued just a month ago

news.title: Tyson Foods Revises 2026 Outlook Due to ‘Beef Pressures,’ And Stock Takes a Hit
news.summary: Tyson Foods updated its fiscal 2026 outlook Thursday. Investors aren’t too pleased.

news.title: 🔎 Under the Radar: Tyson Stock Plunges as Beef Business Weighs on Outlook
news.summary: Shares of Tyson Foods slumped 7% Thursday after the meatpacker said it expects steeper losses in its beef business for the fiscal year.  With its fiscal year ending this month, the company now says it plans to lose between $625 million and $775 million in its beef business.  A cattle shortage in the U.S. is driving up beef prices and squeezing meatpacker’s profits.

news.title: Tyson Foods Cuts Revenue Guidance, Citing Cattle Pressure
news.summary: The company said that it expects revenue in fiscal 2026 to rise by 1.5% to 2%, down from a previous range of 2.5% to 3.5%.

news.title: US DOJ widens beef price inquiry to Walmart, Costco and other major retailers
news.summary: The department will seek records linked to retail beef sales and prices, wholesale purchases, costs and margins, and pricing and purchasing strategies.

news.title: Trump’s New Beef with Meat Packers Won’t Fix Record Ground Beef Prices Before Midterms
